description: This file declares the GstRialtoDecryptorPrivate class, which manages decryption of GstBuffer objects within a GStreamer plugin, including setting decryption services and protection metadata.

classes.name: GstRialtoDecryptorPrivate
classes.description: A class responsible for decrypting GstBuffer objects, managing decryption and protection metadata within a GStreamer transform element.

methods.name: GstRialtoDecryptorPrivate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decryptor with parent element and wrapper factory.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption on a GstBuffer using the associated decryption service.

methods.name: setDecryptionService
methods.description: Sets the decryption service object used for decrypting buffers.

methods.name: setProtectionMetadataWrapper
methods.description: Sets the protection metadata wrapper object.

methods.name: createProtectionMetaInfo
methods.description: Creates a GstStructure containing protection metadata based on provided protection data.
